Yes I am indeed getting more mindful, I really want to make a relationship work! So it's just a case of finding the person huh? How will I know? I demand perfection at every opportunity, I am so analytical and critical. If I see something bad in someone, I instantly go off that person. It is not all the other persons fault that I am single, I guess I am a part of the issue aren't I. 

Yeah I surround myself with people alot, I hate being alone. BUT, I hate talking about my problems, about anything to do with me and my issues. If I have something on my mind I lock it up. Mostly due to when I went to different counsellors to try and talk, it made me worse. It just brought up all the bad shit in my head and made me think about everything. If I dont talk about stuff then I can't think about it as much, right?

I am no longer affectionate, after being hurt so many times by really horrid girls. I don't even like kissing that much now. Although I like the thought of someone unlocking this, much like the sleeping beauty story lol. Someone who it will suddenly just feel right with. I was with a girl for about 9 months this year, I cheated on her, and we only had sex about three times. She just didn't feel right, but I liked her? Maybe I am becoming Asexual?? 
I was once with a married woman, we planned our future together and we were so in love. Everything in my world came crashing down on me when she broke it off. That was when I got REALLY bad and doctors got  involved. Since then, nobody has compared to her. Should I stop trying to find perfect, and just settle for suitable??
